title: Peak hours hardcoded instead of learned from data
description: Coaching peak hour detection hardcodes 9-12 and 14-17. Comment says 'a future enhancement could read this from semantic facts'. Affects UserSituation coaching signals.
effortNote: Needs algorithm design: query historical activity by hour, compute peak productivity windows. Reclassified from medium.

title: Subagent spawning not wired in execution handler
description: execute_task() creates an execution DB record and returns ExecuteResult::Started but never actually spawns a subagent. The SpawnHandler injection point exists but is not connected.
effortNote: Wire SpawnHandler into ExecutionHandler, implement spawn logic (new agent loop instance with task context). Touches execution.rs + agent builder init. Needs careful design for task isolation.

title: Plugin agent_ask_user always returns error
description: The agent_ask_user WASM host function is a stub that always returns {"error":"agent callbacks not connected"} regardless of plugin permissions. WASM plugins cannot prompt users. Referenced as 'Task #8' but no tracking exists.
effortNote: Requires callback bridge from WASM host → agent loop → channel (UI prompt). Crosses 3 architectural layers. Need async callback plumbing through the plugin runtime.

title: Plugin tool_return result is silently discarded
description: The tool_return host function only logs the result via info!() but never writes it to shared state that PluginManager reads. Plugin tool results are silently lost.
effortNote: Need shared memory mechanism between WASM host functions and PluginManager. Could use Arc<Mutex<Option<String>>> or write to WASM linear memory. ~40 lines but needs careful concurrency design.

title: Abstractive compressor mode silently falls back to Extractive
description: CompressorMode::Abstractive variant exists but when no SummaryProvider is wired (the normal case), it silently falls back to extractive. LlmSummaryProvider exists but is not wired at app init.
effortNote: Wire LlmSummaryProvider into ContextEngine at app init. Need to inject LLM provider dependency, configure token budgets for summaries. Touches init + context_engine builder.

title: Net worth history returns current snapshot only
description: report_net_worth_history always returns only today's snapshot with a note 'Historical snapshots are not yet available'. The historical time-series data store and query are not implemented despite the action being advertised in the tool schema.
effortNote: Need new table for daily net-worth snapshots, a cron job to record them, and a query endpoint. Schema + scheduling + query. ~80+ lines across 3 files.

title: Cross-currency transfers not supported
description: Transfer action hard-errors when source and destination currencies differ. No FX conversion path is wired even though PriceService and ensure_base_amount exist in the same crate.
effortNote: Wire PriceService for FX rate lookup, compute converted amount, record both sides of the transfer with correct currencies. ~40 lines but needs financial correctness validation.

title: Remote content loading silently skipped
description: Only local path sources are loaded in the content registry. Any ContentConfig source with a remote URL is ignored with 'Remote loading deferred to async refresh (future work)'.
effortNote: HTTP client integration, caching strategy, async refresh loop. Full networking feature. ~80+ lines.

title: ContradictionDetected event has no subscribers
description: The ContradictionDetected domain event variant exists (Phase 3 prep) and is emitted from cognitive background service, but nothing subscribes to it yet.
effortNote: Need to design what should happen on contradiction detection (notify user? auto-resolve? log for review?). Then wire subscriber. Design decision + implementation.

title: cognitive_facts uses Vec<String> instead of SemanticFact type
description: DecompositionContext::cognitive_facts is declared as Vec<String> placeholder for the typed SemanticFact struct. Cognitive facts are downgraded to raw strings during task decomposition.
effortNote: feature-tasks (L4) cannot import cognitive (L5). SemanticFact type needs to be extracted to common or a shared crate. Reclassified from medium.

title: ArchivedSettings page is placeholder empty state
description: Page renders static 'No archived threads / Thread archiving is coming soon' with no data wiring. Blocked on backend support for thread archiving.
effortNote: Blocked on backend thread archiving feature. Needs: archive flag on sessions, filter query, archive/unarchive commands, then frontend wiring. Full feature.

title: GitSettings page is coming-soon placeholder
description: Zero functionality. Renders only a GitBranch icon and 'Git integration coming soon'. No backend wiring.
effortNote: Entire git integration feature. No backend exists. Scope undefined.

title: EnvironmentsSettings page is coming-soon placeholder
description: Zero functionality. Renders only a Container icon and 'Environment management coming soon'. No backend wiring.
effortNote: Entire environments feature. No backend exists. Scope undefined.

title: Browser Extension integration is placeholder
description: IntegrationsSettings card renders static 'Chrome extension coming soon' paragraph. No onClick, no IPC call.
effortNote: Requires building a Chrome extension + communication bridge to desktop app. Major new project.

title: OKR Suggest KR button has no handler
description: The 'Suggest next KR' button renders with title='Ask AI to suggest next Key Result (coming soon)' but has no onClick handler. Clicking does nothing.
effortNote: No backend endpoint exists. Needs agent integration. Reclassified from medium to large.

title: Image occlusion card type is a stub
description: The image_occlusion card type routes to ImageOcclusionCard() which renders 'Image cards coming soon' with an ImageOff icon. The card type exists in the data model but has no real renderer.
effortNote: Image occlusion requires: image upload/storage, canvas-based region selection for occlusion zones, reveal interaction, and backend support. Full feature.

title: Voice input non-functional in Tauri desktop
description: VoiceInput falls back to 'Voice input is not supported in this browser'. Tauri WebView (WKWebView) doesn't expose SpeechRecognition API. No native microphone API bridge exists.
effortNote: Need native macOS speech recognition bridge via Tauri plugin or platform-macos crate. AVFoundation/Speech framework integration. ~200+ lines across Swift/Rust/TS.

title: Vim multi-selection stubs (ProseMirror limitation)
description: isInMultiSelectMode() always returns false, forEachSelection only invokes with single selection. Vim visual-block and multi-cursor features silently behave as single-selection.
effortNote: ProseMirror fundamentally uses single selection. Multi-selection requires a custom selection plugin layer. Significant editor engineering.

title: Vim fold and hard-wrap commands are no-ops
description: foldCode() (za/zc/zo) and hardWrap() (gq) commands silently do nothing in the ProseMirror vim adapter.
effortNote: Code folding needs a ProseMirror decoration plugin for collapsible sections. Hard-wrap needs paragraph reformatting at a column width. ~60+ lines each.
